title: Celadon_City
lead_summary:
Celadon City is a big city, with two entries: Route 16 to the West and Route 7 to the East.
This city contains Celadon City's Gym, with Erika as its leader.
Team Rocket have a hideout in the Celadon Sewers and Erika will help the player defeat them. After defeating Giovanni, the player will obtain the Silph Scope and can challenge Erika in her gym.

Each will exchange a specific item for more money than they are usually worth, however they will only exchange this item once. ====Big Nugget==== The Hiker will purchase a {{ItemIcon|BIGNUGGET}} Big Nugget for {{P$}}25,000, however if the player has 5 or more Big Nuggets in their bag the Hiker will believe the Big Nuggets are fake and will refuse to make the exchange. ====Pearl String==== The Backpacker will purchase a {{ItemIcon|PEARLSTRING}} Pearl String for {{P$}}50,000. ====Rare Bone==== The Gentleman will purchase a {{ItemIcon|RAREBONE}} Rare Bone for {{P$}}10,000. === Punch Move Tutor === In the Pokémon Center is a Black Belt who will teach [[bulbapedia:Fire Punch (move)|Fire Punch]], [[bulbapedia:Ice Punch (move)|Ice Punch]] and [[bulbapedia:Thunder Punch (move)|Thunder Punch]] to the player's Pokémon for {{P$}}5,000 each === Softboiled Move Tutor === In the hotel is girl who wants the player to give her an Egg, Exeggcute or Togepi. After giving her one, she will teach [[bulbapedia:Soft-Boiled (move)|Soft-Boiled]] to the player's Pokémon for free. === Roost Move Tutor === In the Bottom House, to the Right of the Water Fountain for {{P$}}2,000. ===Rotom TV Room=== After defeating the [[Elite Four]], at [[Time|night]] a door will appear on the south side of the building next to the entrance to [[Route 7]]. Within the room is a TV that when interacted with will start a [[List of Static Encounters|battle]] with a Level 45 Rotom. The player can reset this event by defeating the Elite Four again. ===Falkner Rematch=== After clearing [[Mt. Silver]], Falkner can be found on the roof of the Department Store during the [[Time|morning]]. After talking to him, he will appear at the Fighting Arena in [[Vermillion City]] for a [[Gym Leader rematches|rematch]].
